description.message: Downloads of a pkg, a ZIP or a RAR go to your PS4 running PS4Mount, on your own network, instead of this computer.

onLabel.message: Send pkg, ZIP and RAR downloads to the console

relayLabel.message: Experimental: fetch the console's downloads through this browser too

relayHint.message: The browser fetches part of each download and hands it to the console. It helps only with sites that do not slow each connection down, and while the browser stays open; closed, the console goes on by itself.

basketHint.message: Download every part, then press Send: they go together, as one download.

noDrive.message: PS4Mount answers, but no drive is connected

noPermission.message: The browser did not allow reaching that address

unreachable.message: PS4Mount does not answer at $HOST$ ($WHY$): is it running?

refused.message: The console did not take it: $WHY$

kept.message: $NAME$ is in the basket ($N$ parts): press Send in the icon once all are there
